scope: read-only implementation and dependency audit plus committed evidence

decision.reason: W7-01 is not implementation GREEN and the canonical recommendation, confirmation, merge-policy and projected-cost authorities do not exist

verifiedFoundations.fact: generic ResponsibilityPlan and StageTemplate DTO/store authority exists
post-run cost attribution separates measured estimated and unknown and fails hard-budget eligibility closed
frontend UsageReceipt parser preserves measured estimated unknown and currency invariants
media Module declares all ten canonical capabilities

blockers.detail: W7-02 hard-depends on W7-01; signed Stage and Responsibility templates are not published or installed
ProfileRecommendationRevision has zero implementation hits in backend frontend and ecommerce bundle content
CreateResponsibilityPlanRequest.profile and CreateStageTemplateRequest.profile remain arbitrary nonblank strings
No versioned CostRange/projected-cost contract; existing cost attribution is retrospective UsageReceipt aggregation
No exact Provider price revision, stage quantity assumptions, currency, tax, contingency, confidence or validity window model
No policy authority for minimum profile, forced upgrade, allowed downgrade or required unknown handling
No confirmation command with recommendation hash, actor, reason, ETag/CAS and Idempotency-Key
No invalidation from Brief Evidence Eval template policy provider price license or budget drift to recommendation and confirmation
responsibilityTemplateRefs and productionContractRefs are empty; evalPackRefs remains placeholder
No Workshop UI/SDK parser for recommendation reasons cost/time range unknowns and explicit user confirmation
No W7-02 positive real-tenant and negative isolation-canary evidence exists

recommendation: exact Brief Evidence Eval ResponsibilityTemplate MergePolicy Policy ProviderPrice refs
stable LITE STANDARD FULL profile key
cost and duration ranges with unknowns confidence assumptions currency and expiry
immutable content hash and stale reasons
confirmation: exact recommendation revision and content hash
actor reason policy decision and timestamp
no silent downgrade and no start side effect
targetContract.costBoundary: projected cost is recommendation evidence; actual cost remains canonical UsageReceipt plus Attribution and Adjustment, and unknown or estimated cost is not hard-budget eligible
targetContract.driftBoundary: any frozen input or price/provider/template/policy/license change makes the recommendation stale and requires recomputation and reconfirmation

backend.meaning: generic production contracts and retrospective cost authority are stable; this does not prove W7-02
